title: Workflow service — CRUD + execution orchestration
description: Create workflowService.ts that handles workflow CRUD (load/save/delete/list) via Tauri filesystem and execution orchestration (step chaining with checkpoint gates between steps). Thin wrapper over existing agent APIs.
action: Create src/services/workflowService.ts with loadWorkflows, saveWorkflow, deleteWorkflow, executeWorkflow, executeNextStep, approveStep, rejectStep functions. Uses Tauri FS for storage and delegates to agentWrite/agentRevise/callAnalysisAgent for step execution.

criteria: src/services/workflowService.ts exists and exports workflowService object
workflowService has executeWorkflow(workflowId: string, chapterId: string): Promise<WorkflowExecution>
workflowService has approveStep(execution: WorkflowExecution, modifiedOutput?: string): Promise<WorkflowExecution>
File uses Tauri FS readFile/writeFile for workflow JSON storage
File uses agentWrite or callAnalysisAgent based on step.agentMode
convergence.verification: npx tsc --noEmit exits 0; service imports resolve correctly
convergence.definition_of_done: Workflow service provides full CRUD and step-by-step execution orchestration with checkpoint gates

files.change: New service module with CRUD functions and execution orchestration

implementation: Import agentWrite, agentRevise, agentGetContext from src/api/agents.ts
Define WORKFLOWS_DIR constant for Tauri FS path (app data dir + '/workflows/')
Implement loadWorkflows(): read all JSON files from WORKFLOWS_DIR, parse as Workflow[], merge with builtin templates
Implement saveWorkflow(workflow): write workflow JSON to WORKFLOWS_DIR/{id}.json, skip if isBuiltin
Implement deleteWorkflow(id): delete JSON file, reject if isBuiltin or id starts with 'builtin-'
Implement executeWorkflow(workflowId, chapterId): find workflow, create WorkflowExecution with status='idle', call executeNextStep

Implement executeNextStep(execution): get current WorkflowStep, assemble input from inputSource (previous_step → last stepResult.output, chapter_content → editor content, story_bible → project data, outline → outline data), call appropriate agent function based on step.agentMode ('writing' → agentWrite, 'analysis' → callAnalysisAgent, 'evaluation' → callAnalysisAgent, 'custom' → agentWrite), store result in stepResults, if step.checkpoint !== 'none' set status='paused' and return, else advance currentStepIndex and continue or set status='completed'
Implement approveStep(execution, modifiedOutput?): advance to next step, use modifiedOutput if provided, call executeNextStep
Export workflowService object with all functions

success_metrics: All functions properly typed with Workflow/WorkflowExecution types

reference.pattern: Follow templateService.ts pattern for Tauri FS read/write with builtin- prefix detection. Follow existing service export pattern (object with methods).

rationale.chosen_approach: Thin orchestration service wraps existing agent APIs rather than reimplementing AI capabilities. Sequential execution with checkpoint gates between steps keeps V1 simple.
decision_factors: Existing agent APIs provide all AI capabilities
Tauri FS consistent with template storage pattern
rationale.tradeoffs: No parallel step execution in V1 — deferred per analysis

affected_requirements: F-007: Step input from previous output
